title: RefusalMechInterp matched-triple item
description: Per docs/DATASET_PLAN.md section 2 (supersedes the earlier schema used under docs/BRIEF.md section 3 — field/category names changed 2026-08-15: triple_id->matched_triple_id, text->prompt_text, topic->focus (narrowed to the specific trigger phrase, XSB-style), category names now diet-fasting-tracking/endurance-training-log/supplement-titration/control-risk, source values now constructed/xstest/or-bench).

matched_triple_id.description: Shared id linking the (a)/(b)/(c) items of one matched triple, e.g. 'diet-fasting-tracking_003'.

tier.description: a = benign, explicit self-report/control framing; b = ambiguous, framing present but thin; c = genuine-risk analog, framing absent (pulled unmodified from XSTest/OR-Bench for control-risk, or a same-topic risk analog sourced the same way for the other three categories).

prompt_text.description: The prompt text sent to the model.

focus.description: XSB-style annotation: the specific key phrase that may cause refusal (restriction/quantity/timeframe/self-report language). This is the independent variable for Step 1 path patching.

source.description: constructed = authored here (tiers a/b of the three novel categories only). control-risk items and all tier-c items MUST be xstest/or-bench, unmodified.

source_id.description: Original id/index in the source benchmark, if source != constructed.

token_spans.description: Character-offset spans for Step 1 path-patching token classes, populated per-model at patching time (tokenizer-dependent), not at dataset-build time.
